description.en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance.

description.zh: 用来标记当前查询结束的位置，以便下一次调用时作为参数传入，继续翻页。首次调用或返回最后一页时，取值为空字符串。
description.en: The token that marks the end position of the previous returned page. To obtain the next batch of data, call the operation again by using the value of NextToken returned by the previous request. If you call this operation for the first time or want to query all results, set NextToken to an empty string.
The number of queries to be returned. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh: 授权的Topic，支持mqtt多级topic与通配符。
description.en: The topic whose authorization information you want to query. Multi-level topics and wildcard characters are supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt query-custom-auth-permission --instance-id post-cn-0pp12gl0000 --identity-type USER --identity test --topic test --next-token AAAAAThmKW2HkRgzo4G7IRRTK2fC6zZmAk6y0bwoNPFOOcSP --size 100 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun onsmqtt QueryCustomAuthPermission --region cn-hangzhou --IdentityType USER --NextToken AAAAAThmKW2HkRgzo4G7IRRTK2fC6zZmAk6y0bwoNPFOOcSP --InstanceId 'post-cn-0pp12gl0000' --Size 100 --Identity test --Topic test
